title: validation-state.json
description: Ledger of validation assertions (VAL-*) and their pass/fail/pending status. Each key is a VAL-* ID mapping to its current state.

assertions.description: Map of VAL-* assertion IDs to their status objects

validatedAtMilestone.description: Milestone at which this assertion was validated

validatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last validation attempt

evidence.description: Path to evidence file proving this assertion
